subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or replace it with a narrower current-main fix for this Dashboard recovery bug?
rationale: The issue is valid and paired with an open candidate PR, but the remaining path crosses UI, Gateway session state, and stale PR merge-risk boundaries.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while aligning the fix with current `hasActiveRun` and chat lifecycle code.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update the open PR against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another review.

options.title: Close after replacement
options.body: If a newer PR becomes the viable fix path, close the stale candidate PR and keep this issue linked to the replacement.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while aligning the fix with current `hasActiveRun` and chat lifecycle code.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main chat/session refactor this fix must align with is most closely tied to steipete's recent area history.
